_comment: Mirror of the `hooks` object in .claude/settings.json — same events, same matchers,
same timeouts, pointing at .codex/hooks/ instead of .claude/hooks/.
scripts/check_agent_parity.py fails the gate when the two diverge.
Paths are NOT absolute. They used to be, four times over, which pinned this file to
one machine and one checkout location — it broke on a move or a fresh clone. `codex
--help` documents no project-dir variable, so each command resolves the repo root
itself via git and runs the hook relative to it. That also picks the *worktree* root
when an agent runs in one, which is the same correctness fix post-edit.sh and
stop-gate.sh carry internally: grade the tree being worked in, not the one the
session started in. $CODEX_PROJECT_DIR stays as a fallback for a non-git checkout.
`exec` keeps stdin intact — the hook payload arrives that way.
